candidates.name: Erdheim-Chester disease
support_spans: bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes of the distal femora and proximal tibiae
intramedullary sclerosis of the distal humeri
sclerosis of the proximal ulnae and radii without fracture
bilateral symmetric uptake in long bones, right clavicle, and mandible, with uptake in subcutaneous and muscle tissues of the lower limbs
diffuse infiltration by foamy histiocytes and fibrosis with rare Touton-like giant cells
Immunohistochemical staining of the histiocytes was positive for CD68, CD163, and factor XIIIa, and negative for CD1a, S100, and langerin
candidates.why: The combination of skeletal findings, including bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes and intramedullary sclerosis, along with the presence of foamy histiocytes and Touton-like giant cells on biopsy, is highly suggestive of Erdheim-Chester disease.
